query:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing cheerleader, Bob is playing right winger, and Claire is playing fullback.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Finally, Claire and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) cheerleader
(B) right winger
(C) fullback
note: UNLABELED external package; reference = first successful rollout; all other successful rollouts are omitted so the annotator view matches annotate.py

steps.content: At the end of the match, Alice is playing fullback (C).

NOTE Initially, Alice is playing cheerleader, Bob is playing right winger, and Claire is playing fullback. First, Claire and Alice trade positions. This means Alice now plays fullback, and Claire is back as a cheerleader.
